moves.label: Trade: Robert Covington, Norman Powell, Eric Bledsoe, Keon Johnson, Justise Winslow
moves.description: Robert Covington and Norman Powell were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers from the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for: Eric Bledsoe, Keon Johnson, Justise Winslow, a 2025 2nd round pick (DET own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Marvin Bagley III, Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye and others
moves.description: Marvin Bagley III was acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, a Least Favorable 2023 2nd round pick and a 2024 2nd round pick (SAC own). Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for Serge Ibaka, the draft rights to David Michineau and cash. Serge Ibaka, a Least Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (POR own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Donte DiVincenzo, Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye and the draft rights to Ilkan Karaman. Donte DiVincenzo, Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, the draft rights to Ilkan Karaman, the draft rights to David Michineau, a 2024 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for Marvin Bagley III, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a 2024 2nd round pick (POR own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Bones Hyland, Thomas Bryant, Bones Hyland, Davon Reed, Patrick Beverley and others
moves.description: Bones Hyland was acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for a 2024 2nd round pick (LAC own), a 2025 2nd round pick (LAC own) and a TPE. Thomas Bryant and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Bones Hyland, Davon Reed and a 2024 2nd round pick (DEN own). Patrick Beverley, a 2024 2nd round pick (DEN own) and cash were acquired by the Orlando Magic in exchange for Mo Bamba. Mo Bamba, Davon Reed, a 2024 2nd round pick (LAC own), a 2025 2nd round pick (LAC own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for Patrick Beverley, Thomas Bryant and cash.

moves.label: Trade: Luke Kennard, Danny Green, Danny Green, John Wall, Eric Gordon and others
moves.description: Luke Kennard and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Danny Green, a More Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (TOR own) and a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own). Danny Green, John Wall, a Swap 2023 1st round picks and a TPE were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Eric Gordon. Eric Gordon, a More Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (TOR own) and a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own) were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for Luke Kennard, John Wall, a Swap 2023 1st round picks and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks.

moves.label: Trade: Mason Plumlee, Reggie Jackson
moves.description: Mason Plumlee and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers from the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for: Reggie Jackson, a 2028 2nd round pick (LAC own) and cash.

moves.label: Trade: K.J. Martin, Vanja Marinkovic, Josh Christopher, Vanja Marinkovic, Dillon Brooks and others
moves.description: K.J. Martin and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a TPE. Josh Christopher, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic and a TPE were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Dillon Brooks. Dillon Brooks, the draft rights to Alpha Kaba and a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own) were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Josh Christopher, Usman Garuba, K.J. Martin, Patty Mills, TyTy Washington, Jr., a 2024 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2025 2nd round pick (MIN own), a Swap 2026 2nd round picks, a 2028 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (HOU own). Patty Mills, a 2024 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (HOU own) were acquired by the Oklahoma City Thunder in exchange for cash. Usman Garuba, TyTy Washington, Jr., a 2025 2nd round pick (MIN own), a 2028 2nd round pick (HOU own) and cash were acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for the draft rights to Alpha Kaba and multiple TPEs.

Martin, Marcus Morris, a More Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a Swap 2027 1st round picks, a 2028 1st round pick (LAC own), a Swap 2029 1st round picks, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAC own) and cash. Martin, Marcus Morris, a More Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a Least Favorable 2026 1st round pick, a 2028 1st round pick (LAC own), a Swap 2029 1st round picks, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAC own), cash and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for James Harden, Filip Petrusev, P.J. Tucker and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: James Harden, Darius Garland
moves.description: James Harden was acquired by the Cleveland Cavaliers from the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for: Darius Garland and a 2026 2nd round pick (CLE own).

moves.label: Trade: Kobe Brown, Ivica Zubac, Isaiah Jackson, Bennedict Mathurin
moves.description: Kobe Brown and Ivica Zubac were acquired by the Indiana Pacers from the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for: Isaiah Jackson, Bennedict Mathurin, a conditional 2026 1st round pick (IND own), a 2028 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2029 1st round pick (IND own) and multiple TPEs.

moves.label: Trade: Vanja Marinkovic, Chris Paul, Chris Paul, Ochai Agbaji, Ochai Agbaji and others
moves.description: The draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for Chris Paul and cash. Chris Paul and a TPE were acquired by the Toronto Raptors in exchange for Ochai Agbaji and a 2032 2nd round pick (TOR own). Ochai Agbaji, a 2032 2nd round pick (TOR own) and cash were acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic.

moves.label: Trade: John Collins, Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser, Tarik Biberovic, A.J. Johnson and others
moves.description: A conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own) and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for John Collins and cash. Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser and the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own) and a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own). Khris Middleton, a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for D'Angelo Russell, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks, a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE. Caris LeVert, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gary Harris and Taurean Prince. A.J. Johnson, D'Angelo Russell, Isaiah Stewart II, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks and a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Santi Aldama, the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own). John Collins, Gary Harris, Taurean Prince, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Caris LeVert, Marcus Sasser, Isaiah Stewart II, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own).

moves.label: Trade: Max Strus, Ismael Kamagate, Peyton Watson, Peyton Watson, Cam Whitmore and others
moves.description: Max Strus was acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for the draft rights to Ismael Kamagate, a 2027 2nd round pick (PHL own) and a TPE. A 2031 1st round pick (CLE own), a 2032 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Peyton Watson. Peyton Watson, Cam Whitmore, the draft rights to Ismael Kamagate and a TPE were acquired by the Cleveland Cavaliers in exchange for Dennis Schroder, Max Strus, a 2031 1st round pick (CLE own), a 2032 2nd round pick (SAC own), cash and a TPE. Dennis Schroder and cash were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for Tre Mann. Tre Mann, a 2027 2nd round pick (PHL own) and cash were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Cam Whitmore.
